name: Bar-tailed godwit
desc: A long-billed shorebird that eats mostly worms, with some bivalves and crustaceans. It breeds in the Arctic and winters along coasts of Europe and Africa.
about: The bar-tailed godwit is a large and strongly migratory wader in the family Scolopacidae, which feeds on bristle-worms and shellfish on coastal mudflats and estuaries.
